tasks.title: Email to English teacher about reading club priorities
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.subject: Reading club for teenagers
paragraphs: As you know, we are planning a reading club for teenagers at the library. I need your help to decide on a few things.
First, should we meet on Saturday mornings or weekday evenings? Which do you think is better for students?
Also, we need to choose a type of book to start with. Would you prefer adventure stories or science fiction?
Finally, can you suggest one fun activity we could do during the meetings?
Let me know what you think! Best wishes, Mrs. Hill

promptBlocks.heading: Notes for your reply
listItems: Say which time you prefer and why.
Choose a book type and give a reason.
Suggest one activity for the meetings.
Ask Mrs. Hill about something you need for the club.

promptBlocks.text: Write your email to Mrs. Hill using all the notes.

tasks.title: Article about reading club for teenagers
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: A library reading club for teenagers is starting in your town.
Tell us what you think about this idea. Would you join a reading club? Why or why not? What kind of books would you like to read there?
Write an article answering these questions and we will put it on our website!

tasks.title: Story about a library discovery
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Your English teacher has asked you to write a story.
Your story must begin with this sentence:
"When I opened the old book, a small key fell out and landed on the floor."
